periods.gece_desc: Night worship is very precious. If possible, perform Tahajjud and night dhikr.
periods.sabah_sonrasi_desc: From after Fajr until sunrise. No optional prayers — time for dhikr and supplication.
periods.kerahat_sabah_desc: About 45 minutes after sunrise. Optional prayers are disliked. Dhikr and Quran can be read.
periods.kusluk_desc: Blessed time from after Kerahat until Dhuhr. Ishraq and Duha prayers can be performed.
periods.ogle_desc: From Dhuhr until Asr. A good time for Quran, salawat, and dhikr.
periods.ikindi_desc: From Asr until Kerahat. Prayers on Wednesdays in this period are especially accepted.
periods.kerahat_aksam_desc: About 45 minutes before sunset. Optional prayers are disliked. Dhikr and istighfar recommended.
periods.aksam_desc: From Maghrib until Isha. Blessed time for evening dhikr.
periods.yatsi_desc: After Isha prayer, including Witr and pre-sleep deeds.
periods.yatmadan_desc: Deeds recommended to be done before going to sleep.
periods.ezan_desc: Things to do during Athan. Doing these at every Athan brings great reward.
